description: Catalytic triad and oxyanion hole geometry for AT5G03810, its closest paralogs, characterised Arabidopsis GELPs and four experimental SGNH structures
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
def parse(t):
    A=[]
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            A.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),
                          xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return A
D=lambda a,b: float(np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-b['xyz']))
def site(A):
    idx={(a['resi'],a['name']):a for a in A}
    for s in [a for a in A if a['resn']=='SER' and a['name']=='OG']:
        for hn in [a for a in A if a['resn']=='HIS' and a['name']=='NE2']:
            if D(s,hn)<3.6:
                nd1=idx.get((hn['resi'],'ND1'))
                if nd1 is None: continue
                ac=next((a for a in A if a['resn'] in('ASP','GLU') and a['name'] in('OD1','OD2','OE1','OE2') and D(nd1,a)<3.6),None)
                if ac is None: continue
                don=sorted([(round(D(s,a),2),a['resn'],a['resi'],a['name']) for a in A
                     if a['name'] in ('N','ND2','NE2') and D(s,a)<6.5 and not(a['resi']==hn['resi'] and a['name']=='NE2')])
                return dict(ser=s['resi'],his=hn['resi'],acid=ac,d_SH=round(D(s,hn),2),d_HD=round(D(nd1,ac),2),don=don)
    return None

panel=[("Q9FFN0","AT5G03810 (target)","AF"),("Q9LZC5","At5g03820 (90% id)","AF"),("Q9FFC6","At5g22810 (61%)","AF"),
       ("Q0WPI9","At3g53100 (60%)","AF"),("Q9LU14","APG At3g16370 (56%)","AF"),
       ("Q9FLN0","GLIP1 (secr. lipase)","AF"),("Q9M8Y5","LTL1","AF"),("Q0WUV7","EXL4","AF"),
       ("Q9FXJ2","At1g28580","AF"),("Q9SZW7","At4g30140","AF"),
       ("1IVN","E. coli TAP (PDB 1IVN)","PDB"),("6UQV","P. aeruginosa ChoE (6UQV)","PDB"),
       ("6JL1","V. vulnificus TLH (6JL1)","PDB"),("8A24","L. pneumophila PlaA (8A24)","PDB")]
rows=[]
for acc,lab,src in panel:
    if src=="AF":
        m=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",headers=h,timeout=90).json()[0]
        A=parse(requests.get(m['pdbUrl'],headers=h,timeout=180).text)
    else:
        txt=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{acc}.pdb",headers=h,timeout=120).text
        A=[a for a in parse(txt) if True]
        ch=None
        A2=[]
        for l in txt.split("\n"):
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[21]=='A':
                A2.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),
                               xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66])))
        A=A2
    s=site(A)
    if s is None: continue
    serN=[d[0] for d in s['don'] if d[2]==s['ser'] and d[3]=='N'][0]
    am=[d for d in s['don'] if d[3] in ('ND2','NE2')]
    bb=[d for d in s['don'] if d[3]=='N' and abs(d[2]-s['ser'])>3]
    rows.append(dict(label=lab,src=src,d_SH=s['d_SH'],d_HD=s['d_HD'],d_serN=serN,
                     d_bbN=bb[0][0] if bb else np.nan, bbres=(bb[0][1]+str(bb[0][2])) if bb else "-",
                     d_amide=am[0][0] if am else np.nan, amide=(am[0][1]+str(am[0][2])) if am else "none"))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(T.to_string(index=False)); T.to_csv("active_site_geometry_panel.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6.5),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.15,1]})
y=np.arange(len(T))[::-1]
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(y+0.22,T['d_SH'],height=0.4,label="Ser OG to His NE2",color="#3b6ea5")
ax.barh(y-0.22,T['d_HD'],height=0.4,label="His ND1 to Asp OD",color="#8fb8de")
ax.axvline(3.2,ls='--',c='grey'); ax.text(3.25,len(T)-0.6,"3.2 A H-bond limit",fontsize=8,color='grey')
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(T['label'],fontsize=9); ax.set_xlim(0,4.2)
ax.set_xlabel("distance (A)"); ax.set_title("Catalytic triad hydrogen bonds"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
ax=axes[1]
ax.barh(y+0.25,T['d_serN'],height=0.28,label="Ser backbone N (block I)",color="#2e7d5b")
ax.barh(y,T['d_bbN'],height=0.28,label="block II backbone N",color="#7cc0a0")
cols=["#c44e52" if a.startswith("GLN") else ("#bbbbbb" if a=="none" else "#e8a33d") for a in T['amide']]
ax.barh(y-0.25,T['d_amide'].fillna(0),height=0.28,color=cols,label="block III side-chain amide (orange Asn, red Gln)")
for i,(yy,a) in enumerate(zip(y,T['amide'])):
    if a=="none": ax.text(0.15,yy-0.35,"no amide donor within 6.5 A",fontsize=7,color="#888")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([]); ax.set_xlabel("distance from Ser OG (A)")
ax.set_title("Oxyanion hole donors"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
fig.suptitle("AT5G03810 has a fully assembled SGNH catalytic triad; its clade carries Gln in place of the block III Asn",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
